findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (52.74 yds from volume vs 49.61 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.43 per player (projected 30.48, actual 30.9).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.04 (projected 7.2, actual 7.15).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 65.41, without it 63.57. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 21/61 (34.43%). Our MAE 65.41 vs the line's 58.14. The book is the better projection.
